title: Davidson L6 SVC 20-split replication of the balanced split-stability audit
question: M1.47 在 5 个全新 80/20 split 上得到 5/5 点估计为正、但只有 1/5 CI 正（均值 +2.12pp）。把独立 split 扩到 20 个后，balanced−unweighted 的 split-level 均值是否仍为正，单个 split 的 CI 正率是多少？
scope: replication / split-distribution extension of M1.47; not candidate confirmatory

previous_result.note: The new 20 split seeds are disjoint from the 5 M1.47 seeds; the M1.47 rows are secondary context only.

dataset.name: Davidson et al. 2017 hate speech and offensive language

splits.kind: twenty new independent stratified 80/20 train/test draws
splits.independence_note: Twenty separate partition draws from the same corpus. They are independent split draws, not independent corpora or independent samples; test sets overlap across draws.

modeling.c_selection: per split: unweighted f32 fit only, 5-fold StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=7), accuracy; the selected C is shared by both rules within that split
modeling.test_usage: test labels and test scores are not used for C selection, threshold selection, or rule selection

primary.per_split_bootstrap: 10,000 paired test-level bootstrap resamples, 95% two-sided percentile CI
primary.aggregate: mean, median, standard deviation, min, max of the 20 per-split point deltas; split-level bootstrap 10,000 over the 20 deltas for a 95% percentile CI of the mean delta
primary.split_level_note: The split-level bootstrap treats the 20 split draws as units. It measures split-to-split variability, not population sampling; splits share the same corpus and their test sets overlap, so the interval is approximate.

verdict_rule.supported: split-level 95% CI of the mean delta has low > 0 AND at least 16/20 per-split point deltas are > 0
verdict_rule.directional: mean delta > 0 AND at least 14/20 per-split point deltas are > 0, but the supported condition is not met

primary.sign_gate_rationale: Under a null of 0.5 positive signs, P(X>=16 of 20)=0.0059 and P(X>=14 of 20)=0.0577; the 16/20 gate is the strong sign-stability requirement, while 14/20 is the directional band.
primary.interpretation_limit: Even if supported, this is a replication of one descriptive cell on one corpus. It does not reopen M1.46's candidate line, validate a deployable rule, or make Davidson an official-split benchmark.

secondary: per-split absolute accuracy, macro-F1, hate/non-hate recall, predicted positive rate, and selected C
distribution of per-split point deltas and CI verdicts
append M1.47's five rows as prior context only, not as additional independent splits
exclusions: no target_prior, fit-prior quantile, calibration, or threshold search
no new corpus, re-encoding, MLP, or fine-tuning
